Name: Sir Robert's Tiny Plant Collection
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4]I'm pleased to introduce you to Sir Robert's Tiny Plant Collection, which is a continuation of my houseplant series. The mod consists of houseplants and flowers in pretty vases (or cute pots) that can be placed upon end tables and countertops via the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. Decorate your house with as many flowers and lush houseplants as your heart desires or mix & match them with plants from my other mods. 

Once downloaded, the images can be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer.

Image #1 through #10 consists of flowers/plants that will fit on [u]end tables[/u].

Image #11 is for a group of flowers/plants that have been moved up the screen a few pixels and align best with [u]countertops[/u]. I thought it would be easier to have them separate.

The end tables shown in the images are from mods made by [size=4] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lululovely/mods]lululovely[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats/mods?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/orangeblossom7/mods]Orangeblossom7[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18490]twinkle22[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/smallcopper]smallcopper,[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43300]Creamy Cozy Decor by ENGloomy[/url]. I also included end tables from the Furniture Catalog in Stardew Valley. The countertops are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20541]Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT)[/url] by lululovely and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34287]PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen[/url] by PlatinumCats.[/size]
[/size][size=3]
[size=4][size=4][size=4][u][b]Installation and Usage:[/b][/u][u][b]

[/b][/u][/size][list]
[*][size=4]Install the latest verson of SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=4][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ are not required, but I do recommend them. [/size]
[*][size=4]I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to make life much easier.[/size]
[/list][/size][/size]
[/size][/font]
